map.输入轴承载荷与转速，计算陶瓷（混合）轴承 L10 额定寿命并对比钢轴承: Enter the bearing load and speed to compute the L10 rated life of a ceramic (hybrid) bearing and compare with a steel bearing.
map.L10h = (C/P)^p × 10⁶ / (60×n)；混合陶瓷寿命系数 ≈: L10h = (C/P)^p times 10^6 / (60 times n); hybrid ceramic life factor approx 2.5
map.基于 ISO 281 轴承疲劳寿命公式：额定寿命 L10h 由基本动载荷 C、当: Based on the ISO 281 bearing fatigue-life formula: rated life L10h is computed from basic dynamic load C, equivalent dynamic load P, life exponent p (ball 3, roller 10/3) and speed n; a silicon-nitride hybrid ceramic bearing lasts about 2.5 times a steel bearing, for bearing selection.
map.💡 公式：L10h = (C/P)^p × 10⁶ / (60×n)；混合陶瓷轴: Formula: L10h = (C/P)^p times 10^6 / (60 times n); hybrid ceramic life factor approx 2.5 times (silicon nitride balls reduce friction and stress).
map.L10 寿命指 90% 可靠度下的额定寿命，并非绝对寿命: L10 life is the rated life at 90% reliability, not an absolute life.
map.陶瓷轴承寿命提升系数取 2.5，实际受润滑、温度、污染影响: The ceramic bearing life improvement factor is taken as 2.5; actual values depend on lubrication, temperature and contamination.
map.当 P 超过 C 时寿命极短，建议 P/C ≤ 0.5: When P exceeds C the life is extremely short; keep P/C <= 0.5.
map.📚 深度解析：陶瓷轴承寿命计算（L10 额定寿命与钢轴承对比）: In-depth: Ceramic bearing life calculation (L10 rated life vs steel bearing)
map.选型对比：比较陶瓷混合轴承与全钢轴承的 L10 寿命差异: Selection comparison: compare L10 life difference between hybrid ceramic and all-steel bearings.
map.工况评估：由 P/C 载荷比判断轴承是否选型偏小: Condition assessment: judge from the P/C load ratio whether the bearing size is too small.
map.维护规划：把小时寿命折算为年，安排更换周期: Maintenance planning: convert hourly life to years and schedule replacement.
map.算法：寿命比 = C/P；L10 转数 = (C/P)^p × 10⁶（转，p: Algorithm: life ratio = C/P; L10 revolutions = (C/P)^p times 10^6 (rev, p is the life exponent: ball 3, roller 10/3); steel bearing hourly life = L10 rev / (60 times n); ceramic bearing hourly life = steel life times 2.5 (empirical hybrid-ceramic factor); yearly life = hourly life / 8760; P/C load ratio = P/C times 100%. Assessment: load ratio >50% is high, increase the size; >20% moderate, watch lubrication; otherwise ample life.
map.例：C=25kN、P=5kN、n=3000rpm、p=3（球轴承）→ 寿命比 5: Example: C=25 kN, P=5 kN, n=3000 rpm, p=3 (ball) -> life ratio 5, L10 rev 125.00M, steel 694.4 h (0.079 yr), ceramic 1736.1 h (0.198 yr), P/C=20.0%, assessment: light load, ample life. If load reduced to 2 kN -> life ratio 12.5, L10 rev 1.95G, steel 10850.7 h (1.2 yr), ceramic 27126.7 h (3.1 yr). If load raised to 15 kN -> life ratio 1.667, steel only 25.7 h, P/C=60%, assessment warns: high load, increase bearing size or reduce load.
map.陶瓷轴承寿命真的是钢轴承的 2.5 倍吗？: Is a ceramic bearing really 2.5 times a steel one?
map.2.5 是本工具采用的混合陶瓷轴承（氮化硅滚动体 + 钢套圈）经验系数，源于陶瓷: 2.5 is the empirical factor this tool uses for a hybrid ceramic bearing (silicon nitride rolling elements plus steel rings), from the low density of ceramic balls,
map.小、摩擦系数低且不易发生粘着磨损。实际倍数随载荷、润滑与污染状况变化很大，高速轻: low friction coefficient and low tendency for adhesive wear. The actual multiple varies greatly with load, lubrication and contamination; the advantage is greatest at high speed and light load, and narrows under heavy slow load.
map.L10 是「额定寿命」：一批相同轴承在相同条件下运转，其中 90% 尚未发生疲劳: L10 is the rated life: among a group of identical bearings under the same conditions, the revolutions or hours reached when 90% have not yet suffered fatigue pitting, i.e. 10% will fail before that. It is a fatigue-spalling statistic and excludes non-fatigue modes such as lubrication failure, contamination wear and mounting damage.
map.陶瓷轴承寿命计算器基于 ISO 281 的 L10 额定寿命公式，输入基本动载荷: The ceramic bearing life calculator, based on the ISO 281 L10 rated-life formula, takes basic dynamic load C, equivalent dynamic load P and speed n to compute and compare the rated life of steel and hybrid ceramic bearings, helping engineers assess the life-improvement benefit.
